description: This file defines an Android Fragment named 'ImageGridFragment' responsible for displaying a grid of image thumbnails, managing image loading asynchronously with caching, and handling user interactions like clicks to view image details. It includes internal classes for the grid's adapter and manages layout adjustments dynamically.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: An internal adapter class that provides views for the GridView, manages the number of columns, view heights, and handles the creation of image thumbnail views and placeholder views for the top empty space.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up image cache parameters, and prepares the ImageFetcher for loading images asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the GridView with adapter and event listeners, and configures layout adjustments based on GridView's width.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes image fetching and refreshes the adapter.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses image fetching, clears cache, and ensures smooth scrolling.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Closes the image cache to release resources.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles item clicks, launching a detailed activity with transition animation.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as clearing the image cache.
